title: How to Change the cursor hover behavior in the Linear desktop app in Linear on a Mac
metaTitle: How to Change the cursor hover behavior in Linear on Mac
description: You cannot change the cursor hover behavior in the Linear desktop app because it is a keyboard-first tool. Learn how to optimize your workflow instead.
intro: You cannot change the cursor hover behavior in the Linear desktop app because the application does not include settings for pointer sensitivity or hover delay. Linear is designed as a keyboard-first tool where navigation relies on shortcuts rather than mouse-based interactions.
tldr: Linear does not offer a setting to change cursor hover behavior.
The application is built for keyboard-first efficiency.
Use ⌘ + K to open the command menu for all actions.
Use ⌘ + R to refresh the app if you experience interface issues.
System-wide cursor settings are managed in macOS System Settings.

blocks.text: Why you cannot change cursor in Linear

Many users search for how to change cursor in Linear because they want to adjust hover sensitivity or visual feedback. It is important to know that Linear does not provide these settings. The development team prioritizes a keyboard-driven interface. This design choice aims to keep your hands on the keyboard for maximum speed. Adding mouse-based configuration would conflict with the core philosophy of the application.

The Linear desktop app is an Electron-based wrapper. It loads the web application directly. Because it mirrors the web experience, it lacks deep integration with macOS mouse hardware settings. If you feel the cursor behavior is sluggish, it is likely a system-level issue or a display scaling conflict. You should check your macOS settings instead of looking for app-specific toggles.

Linear is built so you can perform nearly every task without moving your mouse. When you stop trying to change cursor in Linear and start using shortcuts, your productivity will likely increase. The command menu is the most powerful tool in the app. Press ⌘ + K to access it. From there, you can search for issues, change statuses, or assign tasks without a single click.

items: Use ⌘ + K to open the command menu.
Press C to create a new issue instantly.
Use P to set or change issue priority.
Press Space to peek into an issue without clicking.
Use Shift + ? to view all available keyboard shortcuts.

blocks.text: A frequent source of frustration is the naming overlap between Linear and the Cursor AI code editor. Users often search for how to change cursor in Linear when they are actually trying to configure the Cursor editor. These are two completely different applications. If you are looking for AI-powered coding suggestions or interface motion settings, you are looking for the Cursor editor settings, not the Linear project management tool.

If you are having trouble seeing your cursor or if the pointer speed feels wrong, you should adjust these settings at the system level. Open System Settings on your Mac. Navigate to Accessibility and then to Display. You can increase the pointer size here. This will make the cursor easier to find in any app, including Linear. If you need more granular control over acceleration, consider third-party tools that manage mouse drivers.

Remember that Linear is a web-based app wrapped for the desktop. It does not have low-level access to your mouse hardware. Any changes you make in the macOS System Settings will apply globally. This is the only way to effectively change how your mouse interacts with the Linear interface.

faq.question: Can I change the hover speed in Linear?
faq.answer: No, Linear does not have settings for hover speed. The interface is optimized for keyboard interaction.

faq.question: Is there a way to make the cursor larger in Linear?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must do it through macOS System Settings under Accessibility > Display. This affects all applications on your Mac.

faq.question: Why do people think they can change cursor in Linear?
faq.answer: The confusion often stems from the name of the 'Cursor' AI code editor, which has its own extensive UI and hover settings.

faq.question: How do I avoid using the mouse in Linear?
faq.answer: Learn the keyboard shortcuts. Start with ⌘ + K for the command menu and use the arrow keys to navigate issues.

task: Change the cursor hover behavior in the Linear desktop app
requirements: Linear desktop app installed on macOS

steps.name: Access System Settings
steps.text: Since Linear has no cursor settings, open your Mac System Settings to modify global pointer behavior.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Size
steps.text: Select Display and move the Pointer size slider to your desired level for better visibility.

steps.name: Use Command Menu
steps.text: Return to Linear and press ⌘ + K to perform actions instead of hovering with your mouse.

troubleshooting.fix: Refresh the app with ⌘ + R or check your internet connection.
Check the application name in the menu bar to ensure you are in the correct app.
